name: @atlisp/mcp
description: MCP Server for @lisp on CAD,support AutoCAD/GstarCAD/ZWCAD/BricsCAD or CAD platform compatible with AutoLISP

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:worker
scripts.build:worker: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');for(const f of ['cad-worker.js','lisp-security.js','logger.js','config.js'])fs.copyFileSync('src/'+f,'dist/'+f);if(!fs.existsSync('dist/html'))fs.mkdirSync('dist/html');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('src/html'))fs.copyFileSync('src/html/'+f,'dist/html/'+f);if(!fs.existsSync('dist/handlers'))fs.mkdirSync('dist/handlers');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('src/handlers'))fs.copyFileSync('src/handlers/'+f,'dist/handlers/'+f)"
scripts.test:e2e:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml build && vitest run tests/e2e/

author: vitalgg
